subject: mathematics
title: Point Detective
objective: Recognize and describe points, lines, line segments, rays, and special line relationships.
introduction: Milo is planning a beach map. Can you spot the dot, segment, and ray in his route?

vocabulary.definition: An exact dot on a paper or screen that marks a specific location.
A straight path with two definite endpoints that stop.
A straight path with one starting point that goes on forever in one direction.
A straight path with no endpoints that goes on forever in both directions.

activities.instruction: Watch the endpoints and arrows that define each figure.
activities.content: A dot marks one location. A segment stops at two endpoints. A ray starts at one endpoint and continues with an arrow. A line has no endpoints; parallel lines stay apart, while perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

feedback.retry: Check the number of endpoints: a segment has two and a ray has one.

items.prompt: On Milo’s map, which mark names one exact location?

options.text: a wavy curve with no endpoints
a long straight path that never ends

items.explanation: A point marks one exact location; the other choices show paths, not a single dot.

items.prompt: Milo draws a straight path that stops at both ends. What is it?

options.text: a wavy curve with no endpoints

items.explanation: A segment is straight and stops at two endpoints. A ray has one endpoint, and a line continues both ways.

items.prompt: A kite string starts at one point and continues in one direction. Which figure is it?

options.text: a long straight path that never ends

items.explanation: A ray starts at one endpoint and continues in one direction. The other figures have zero or two endpoints.

items.prompt: Milo draws two straight roads that stay the same distance apart. What are they?

options.text: perpendicular lines that meet at one point

items.explanation: Parallel lines stay the same distance apart and never meet. The other line pairs meet or overlap.

items.prompt: Milo labels a dot A. Which statement about points and lines is true?

options.text: a line has exactly one endpoint
a segment goes on forever in both directions

items.explanation: A point marks one location. A line has no endpoints, a ray has one, and a segment has two.
